Body.Content:
Bing Custom Search, soon to be in preview, will let you create a highly-customized web search experience that will deliver better and more relevant results through a commercial grade service. Featuring a straightforward user interface, Bing Custom Search will enable you to create your own web search engine without a line of code. Specify slices of the web that you'll want to draw from, or let cutting-edge AI technology help you identify them. It will empower businesses of any size, hobbyists, and entrepreneurs to design and deploy web search applications for any scenario.

Learn more about Bing Custom Search.
